summary: @servicetitan/folder-lint 38.1.1 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The tarball for this version ships an undeclared root file `math_init.js` (~727KB, single-line string-array-obfuscated bundle with a rotating constant array and decoder functions) and a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that is absent from the legitimate ServiceTitan folder-lint sources. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmod+x's the binary in a temp directory, then invokes that Bun binary against `math_init.js` (execFileSync with stdio inherited). The `dist/` and `src/` trees implement the advertised folder-lint API (checkPath, printFailure, NamingConvention) and function as cover; math_init.js is not referenced by dist/index.js and has no relation to a folder-schema lint helper. The alternate-runtime fetch is used specifically to execute an opaque, heavily obfuscated bundle outside Node's normal resolution surface at install time, which is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern and constitutes install-time remote code execution on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
